Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she saw a big puddle and a bright red leaf. She wanted to play with it, but her mommy said they were all gone. So, Lily went to her and said, "Mommy, this is my hand! It is called a big wind!" 

Her mommy said, "Don't worry, Lily. Let's go get it for a walk to the store. It's a nice spot where we can get it for it." Then, Lily and her mommy went to the store
